policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 6 Mar close (1x4 3.78, 3x6 3.77, 6x9 3.82, 9x12 3.88 vs WIBOR 3M 3.77) price roughly 10bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC cut by 25bp to 3.75% on 4 Mar (a 'hawkish cut', ING); the projection excludes the war. Glapiński (5 Mar): if things calm within about two months, one more cut is back on the table; no forward guidance. Wnorowski (6 Mar): no further cuts while the war lasts; Kotecki: room 'much smaller'.
policy.risk_text: Oil and the war set the direction: if Brent stays near $100 the market keeps pricing NBP hikes and the front-end roll-down reverses; a ceasefire would bring cuts back (Glapiński's 'two months'). SAFE politics add a fiscal premium.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar).
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP (MoF figures in Fitch: 7.0% / 6.5% / 6.2% for 2025-27, debt ~70% of GDP by 2027); 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~38% (25 Feb) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 171.6bn at end-February. Moody's reviews Poland on 20 Mar (A2, negative).
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar after holding at 4.00% in January and February; January flash CPI 2.2%; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative (affirmed 27 Feb), Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 6-8 Mar: the NBP Inflation Report (6 Mar) has central CPI 2.3% (2026), 2.4% (2027), GDP 3.9% (2026); Wnorowski: forget further cuts while the war lasts; Kotecki: room 'much smaller'; the 10Y POLGB rose ~56bp in the week and the 2Y neared 4.0%. Abroad: US payrolls -92k (+55k expected) but Brent rose ~27% in the week to ~$92-93.

calendar.plan_text: MoF March plan (27 Feb): sale auctions on 18 and 25 Mar (PLN 7-13bn each; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731 (new 5Y fixed), DS1035, NZ0936 (new 10Y POLSTR floater)) and a switch on 11 Mar buying back OK0426, DS0726, PS1026, WZ1126 and OK0127; no T-bills; WZ sales ended in February. February sales were ~PLN 41bn; ~38% of 2026 needs financed.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; in March's sell-off MoF is cutting supply (switch instead of sale, a smaller 25 Mar offer), so remaining dates (18 and 25 Mar) are less of a supply event. Next MPC 8-9 Apr: a hold is expected while the market prices hikes.

facts.core_text: Regime: war shock - oil and global yields up, PLN weaker; the NBP cut to 3.75% and turned wait-and-see while FRAs price roughly 10bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the BoE has turned hawkish, the CNB and MNB are on hold. (Erste's CDS/spread table for 6 Mar looked stale or inconsistent, so it is not quoted.) Brent +27% in the week (6 Mar).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: no FPC auction announced yet in March; BGK's February auctions raised PLN 6.4bn incl. additional sales.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
